content.text: In regions where [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/get-payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-working-today-2|payment]] platforms like Stripe and PayPal are unavailable, digital creators face significant challenges in receiving payments. This is especially true in countries like Nigeria and Kenya, where currency instability adds layers of complexity. NOWPayments offers a robust solution for processing cryptocurrency payments automatically, and when integrated with Cloudflare Workers, it creates a seamless experience for delivering digital products without delays.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-setting-up-nowpayments-digital-store-works-how-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment platforms often impose restrictions that can hinder creators from receiving funds efficiently. NOWPayments eliminates these barriers by allowing you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, ensuring that you can process payments without the constraints of location or currency. This infrastructure is designed for resilience, with automatic payment verification that ensures you receive funds promptly, regardless of the conventional banking system's limitations.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before diving into the deployment process, ensure you have the necessary accounts and tools set up. You need a Cloudflare account for hosting and serverless functions, a NOWPayments account for receiving crypto payments, and a service like [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-supabase-order-database-digital-stores-works-how-19|How Supabase]] for storing order data. Familiarize yourself with GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Workers, as these will be integral to your deployment. Gather your digital products and prepare them for upload to your storage solution.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start by configuring your NOWPayments account to generate API keys for payment processing. Next, create a Cloudflare Worker that listens for payment confirmations, allowing you to trigger the delivery of your digital products automatically. Use Supabase to store order details and track payment statuses. Integrate these components to ensure that once a payment is confirmed, your products are delivered without manual intervention, creating a streamlined experience for your customers.
NOWPayments offers over 300 cryptocurrencies for seamless transactions.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

With your infrastructure in place, it's time to go live. Publish your Cloudflare Pages site and ensure that all links to your payment processing and product delivery are working correctly. Conduct a test transaction using a small amount of cryptocurrency to confirm that the payment is processed through NOWPayments and that your product is delivered as expected. Monitor the transaction closely to identify any areas for improvement before scaling your operations.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once you’ve successfully processed your first transaction, you can begin to scale your operations. Add more products to your site and utilize the framework established to expand your offerings. Use the Edge Commerce Stack for enhanced features, including SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration for email deliverability. Analyze transaction data to optimize pricing and marketing strategies, ensuring that your business continues to grow without being hindered by payment processing issues.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-getting-paid-usdt-digital-work-complete-infrastructure-25|COREMERCH guide to getting]] paid in crypto is operationally simpler than it appears. You configure your wallet address in NOWPayments once — this takes under 30 minutes. From that point, every sale deposits automatically into your wallet without any action required from you. The transaction hash in your order log is cryptographic proof of every payment. When you want to convert to local currency, you transfer USDT from your wallet to your exchange account and post a P2P sell order. The buyer sends local currency to your bank account or mobile money account and you release the USDT. Most P2P transactions complete in under 30 minutes.
USDT on Tron keeps transaction costs under $0.10, making it efficient.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The complete payment pipeline — from buyer checkout to local currency in your account — involves three components: NOWPayments for on-chain verification, your sovereign stack backend for order processing and delivery, and a P2P exchange for conversion to local currency. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the first two components under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete process including P2P conversion guidance for Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, and Bangladesh. Both available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Configure your payout destination before configuring your store. Your self-custody wallet address goes into NOWPayments as the destination for each coin you accept — this is where funds land when a transaction confirms on-chain. Never use an exchange wallet address as your NOWPayments destination — use a self-custody wallet where you control the private keys. Set up Binance P2P or a local exchange and verify the conversion process for your local currency pair. Deploy your stack and run a mainnet test. After the first real sale confirms, wait for the transaction to fully clear in NOWPayments, then transfer from your self-custody wallet to your exchange for conversion.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

To receive crypto payments, integrate NOWPayments into your website using Cloudflare Workers. This allows you to process payments instantly, ensuring that you receive funds without relying on traditional payment methods.
How long does USDT payment take to arrive compared to PayPal?

USDT payments on the Tron network are confirmed almost instantly, often within seconds, compared to PayPal, which can take longer due to manual processing. This speed ensures you get your funds quickly.
How do creators in Nigeria convert Bitcoin to naira?

Creators in Nigeria can use peer-to-peer exchanges like Binance or Patricia to convert Bitcoin to naira. These platforms facilitate easy conversion, ensuring that you can access local currency without complications.
What are the fees associated with using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a competitive fee of just 0.5% per transaction, making it an economical choice for creators looking to maximize their earnings while accepting a wide range of cryptocurrencies.
Can I automate my digital product delivery?
Yes, by integrating NOWPayments with Cloudflare Workers, you can automate digital product delivery upon payment confirmation, ensuring a seamless experience for your customers.
Cloudflare Workers enable automated product delivery right after payment confirmation.
